queries.name: Movies by Actor
queries.sql: SELECT DISTINCT m1.name AS movie_name, m1.date FROM movies m1 JOIN casts c1 ON m1.id = c1.movie_id JOIN people p1 ON c1.person_id = p1.id JOIN jobs j1 ON c1.job_id = j1.id JOIN casts c2 ON m1.id = c2.movie_id JOIN people p2 ON c2.person_id = p2.id JOIN jobs j2 ON c2.job_id = j2.id WHERE p1.name = :actor_name AND j1.name ILIKE '%actor%' AND p2.name = :co_star_name AND j2.name ILIKE '%actor%' ORDER BY m1.date NULLS LAST;
queries.original_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m1.name AS movie_name, m1.date
FROM movies m1
JOIN casts c1 ON m1.id = c1.movie_id
JOIN people p1 ON c1.person_id = p1.id
JOIN jobs j1 ON c1.job_id = j1.id
JOIN casts c2 ON m1.id = c2.movie_id
JOIN people p2 ON c2.person_id = p2.id
JOIN jobs j2 ON c2.job_id = j2.id
WHERE p1.name = 'Tom Hanks' AND j1.name ILIKE '%actor%'
  AND p2.name = 'Meg Ryan' AND j2.name ILIKE '%actor%'
ORDER BY m1.date NULLS LAST;
